# GER scope. Spawns the divisions in the first usable city (Tunis > Tripoli > Benghazi > Tobruk).
MFU_ak_spawn_divisions = {
	MFU_ak_create_template = yes
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { MFU_ak_city_tunis = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { MFU_ak_has_medium_tech = yes MFU_ak_has_medium_1940 = yes }
				458 = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Afrikakorps Panzer-Division\" start_experience_factor = 0.5 start_equipment_factor = 1 force_equipment_variants = { medium_tank_chassis_1940 = { owner = \"GER\" version_name = \"Panzer III Ausf.H\" } }"
						owner = GER
						prioritize_location = 11969
						count = 3
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { MFU_ak_has_medium_tech = yes }
				458 = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Afrikakorps Panzer-Division\" start_experience_factor = 0.5 start_equipment_factor = 1 force_equipment_variants = { medium_tank_chassis_1946 = { owner = \"GER\" version_name = \"Panzer IV\" } }"
